testDecision: No Test window. AlembicPlugin owns isolated unit/integration and detached two-root MCP probes. taskPackages.summary: Repair the verified remaining AlembicPlugin five-tool usability defects found by controller calls against the existing BiliDili and AlembicWorkspace knowledge roots. Reproduce only on isolated copies of the two real roots; never mutate live knowledge during implementation. (1) A plan-confirmed Workspace moduleMining rescan scoped to Alembic/AlembicCore/AlembicPlugin/AlembicDashboard leaked coverage and source evidence into BiliDili and Test/tmp replicas; make rescan/ProjectContext consumption honor the request ProjectScope folder set and confirmed moduleScope, excluding control-root siblings and historical Test/tmp trees. (2) The same rescan classified cleanly inspected Alembic/Core/Dashboard ranges as skipped but left checkpointCommit behind forever while advancing Plugin; advance a folder checkpoint to current HEAD after a successful complete no-op/skipped classification, while preserving failed/truncated/unresolved ranges as stale. Resolve duplicate legacy per-repo versus control-root checkpoint rows deterministically without deleting audit evidence. (3) For BiliDili single-folder, status reports identityAlignment=mismatch while Search/Graph/Recipe Map report current/current over the same root/root row; make public revision truth consistent. (4) Explicit Workspace projectRoot resolves ecf32806 correctly even while selected/active=BiliDili, yet full status degrades businessOk solely for Dashboard handoff mismatch; keep handoff mismatch as diagnostic/launch gating without invalidating explicit pure-local MCP project status. (5) Guard clean output reports appliedRules.total=6 built-ins while separately applying four Recipe rules, and claims every violation has inline recipe although ast_class_bloat violation has none; make rule accounting and fix guidance schema/output honest. Add focused RED/GREEN tests for each case, run check/build/runtime/distribution verification, and return commit plus detached two-root and multi-folder probes. Do not add knowledge, run dimension production, create environments, modify Core unless ownership evidence proves Plugin cannot fix a specific slice, or touch BiliDili/Alembic live source/data.

taskPackages.summary: Close the user-authorized remaining AlembicPlugin full-unit-suite gate after the real five-tool work has been accepted. Start from clean commit 6e3ba4ba6ea818075f64c535fad8b267d794a3c8. Reproduce and root-cause the nine stable failures from the controller's 2026-07-12 full run: five ProposalExecutor deprecate/snapshot assertions, three HostAgentSessionLease deepMining/session-round lifecycle assertions, and CodexSessionScenarioRunner bootstrap-missing-ai savedProjectRootWritten. Separately handle the eight 10-second failures that occur only under the 163-file parallel full suite but pass in a single-worker rerun (GuardRequestDataRootIsolation x2, HostMcpServer sequential Search, PlanDrivenGenerationGate moduleMining, ProjectGraphTool repo cap, RetrievalCheckpointDiagnostics x3). Make the smallest correct Plugin-owned code/test-harness changes so current intended behavior is tested and `npm run test:unit` passes as a whole; do not blindly raise timeouts, weaken assertions, skip tests, serialize the entire suite, or restore retired knowledge-production behavior without proving why. For every assertion mismatch, determine whether production behavior is wrong or the test encodes an obsolete contract, and record the conclusion. Preserve request-scoped project/data-root isolation, current rescan convergence semantics, no-production boundaries, and all already accepted five-tool behavior. Use only temporary fixtures; never open or mutate the live BiliDili/Workspace knowledge roots. Modify and commit AlembicPlugin only. If a failure is truly Core-owned, stop that slice and return exact ownership evidence instead of editing Core from this package. Run the affected files first, then the exact full `npm run test:unit`, `npm run check`, `npm run build`, runtime package verification, plugin distribution verification, and Codex plugin verification. Return commit, diff, raw command summaries, failure-to-fix mapping, and two-stage self-review.
